currentDistribution.boundary: vNext distribution retains all 39 pinned adapted sources, licenses and attachments. Only seven frontmatter blocks change: five Office capabilities explicitly declare work/code; self-improving-agent and skill-creator drop the retired learn mode while retaining work/code. All other 32 directories are byte-identical to the immediate predecessor. Historical source, adaptation, managed predecessor hashes and reviewed upstream revisions retain their original meaning. Five Firefly-maintained builtins ship separately; persona and workflow support are prompt composition inputs, not new runtime loaders.
